sn_aia_version.instructions: 1. Read JR by sys_id -> number, role_title, required_skills, nice_to_have_skills, experience_years_required, education_required, responsibilities, stage. JR missing -> stop and report. 2. Read latest APPROVED/PUBLISHED JD (jd_text). Missing -> stop and report. 3. Query applications: requisition = JR, withdrawn = false, screening_status = PENDING or ERROR, oldest first. Empty -> stop and report. Fix the queue. 4. Take the next application. Get its resume (one call per application). 5. Resume empty, under 100 chars or unreadable -> Create Screening Result with screening_status ERROR, empty scores, "None evidenced" skill lists, reason in explanation, is_blind_scored false. Update Application screening_status ERROR. Go to step 9. 6. Score (blind, resume text only): a. skills = 0.8*required% + 0.2*nice%; per skill used 1, listed only 0.5, absent 0. b. experience = min(100, relevant years / required years * 100); empty if required = 0 or no dates/years. c. education = met/above 100, one below 50, else 0; empty if unstated. d. projects = min(100, points/4*100) over the top 3 projects; empty if none. e. certifications = share of certs named in JR/JD that are evidenced and unexpired; empty if none named. f. Round each factor to a whole number. 7. fit_score = sum(weight * score) / sum(weights of scored factors), rounded. Weights: skills 35, experience 25, education 15, projects 15, certifications 10. Write the weights used in the explanation. Build matched, missing, transferable lists ("None evidenced" if empty) and the explanation. 8. Create Screening Result (COMPLETED). Sys ID returned -> Update Application screening_status COMPLETED. No sys_id -> Update Application ERROR. 9. More applications in the queue -> step 4. Else continue. 10. Log Resume Screening Run once. 11. Report Completed, Error, Total. Completed + Error = Total.
